name: the user's own Profile

regions_read.verdict_on_region: the account holder's own name — names a person, not the section (no 'Profile' title anywhere)
content: the prompt of a bottom sheet offering avatar creation, not a place — dismissed

identifier_found: the account holder's name 'Ally Cooper' top-left with share and settings icons; the tab bar (or, on s28, the avatar sheet) with no highlighted item
initial_rationale: the header names a person, not the section; no 'Profile' title; no tab is highlighted

test_cases.action: tap ⋯ then Profile; dismiss the avatar sheet with MAYBE LATER; scroll the profile down and back
test_cases.expected_result: a 'Profile' title or a highlighted tab appears, or none does
test_cases.observed_result: 'Create your avatar!' sheet covered the lower half (no tab bar); MAYBE LATER revealed the profile with the tab bar and no tab boxed; scrolling kept 'Ally Cooper' pinned and never showed a 'Profile' title

deciding_evidence: the only header is a person's name and the tab bar shows nothing current — the profile is reached through the ⋯ menu, whose menu item says 'Profile', but the screen itself never does; on s28 the 'Create your avatar!' sheet (dismissed as content) hides the tab bar entirely
recommendation: title the screen 'Profile' (or 'Your profile') and highlight the ⋯ tab while it is shown
